name: The Cursed Relic
tagline: Watch it get buried. Then find it before the curse finds you. Voice and camera on.

missions.title: Dig Up the Relic
missions.brief: A cursed object will be shown, then buried. Follow the heat, dig fast, and do not trust the Wail.

missions.title: Second Burial
missions.brief: A new relic, a new grave. Same curse, and it has learned how you search.
